conclusion: No proven contradiction in the five discount comparisons. Verdicts: 1x different_scope_time, 3x insufficient_evidence, 1x consistent (low confidence). This packet does NOT establish comprehensive monitoring of the organization; it covers one concrete goal - protect value and margin while growing sales - and the rules/emergent discount culture around it.
